status: Blender modelling and offline delivery complete; native import and placement belong to Karmei Yosef operator.

units.scale_contract: 1 metre in source = 100 centimetres in Unreal; offline Blender FBX reimport verified, Unreal not opened

materials.base_color: sRGB; alpha is foliage/net opacity mask or film opacity
materials.normal: OpenGL +Y, Non-Color. In Unreal use Flip Green Channel for DirectX tangent convention.
materials.ORM: Non-Color; R = Ambient Occlusion, G = Roughness, B = Metallic
materials.net: Masked, two-sided; BaseColor alpha carries net apertures
materials.film: Translucent, two-sided; BaseColor alpha carries opacity
materials.receiving_operator: FBX cannot reconstruct all shader wiring automatically. Rebuild the material connections from the supplied PNGs and mode entries.

defaults.barn: 20 x 12 m footprint, 6 m eave, 8 m ridge, light grey corrugated metal; no ground photograph available. Roof overhang included in measured bounds.
defaults.net: White default plus black alternative, flat roof, 4 m height.
defaults.strawberries: Open raised bed supplied independently of optional removable low tunnel, compatible with placement beneath a net house.
defaults.unknown_grey_purple_rows: Unidentified in handoff. No crop species or additional asset invented.
defaults.tree_locations: Not assigned from aerial screenshot; placement belongs to operator.

adaptation_notes: NetHouse Bay/Side/Door use the exact unsuffixed handoff names for white defaults; black alternatives use _Black.
Two-dimensional net-house post ownership uses one leading-corner post per bay and separate boundary pieces to avoid doubled shared corner posts.
NetHouse_Post_4m, ClosureBeam_4m, ClosureBeam_8m and Greenhouse_EndArch are four added closure components.
LowTunnel optional terminal hoop is an editable source parameter; repeat modules use start-owned hoops.

pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: 9 m outer film span x 4 m axial pitch x 4.5 m outer film height; source front is -Y.
Ground pivot at centre of leading short end (0,0,0); local X spans -4.5..4.5, local Y spans 0..4.
One steel arch on the leading edge only; tile at (0,j*4,0). Purlins and film end flush at exactly Y=0 and Y=4.
Add End wall at Y=0 and Y=N*4; add one EndArch closure only at Y=N*4-0.07. No duplicate interior arches.
Semi-transparent film: two sided translucent PBR; BaseColor alpha 0.20, roughness 0.28, IOR 1.46. FBX materials need native Unreal recreation.
UCX boxes follow steel arch only. Film and walking volume have no collision. No opaque box across tunnel.

Add exactly one Greenhouse_EndArch at trailing cap; see structures_assembly.md.
Collision only on doorway steel jambs and lintel; no sill or invisible solid blocking the opening.

pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Inferred default farm barn; no ground photograph was supplied. Not a surveyed reconstruction.
Wall footprint 20 x 12 m. Eave 6 m, structural ridge 8 m, roof overhang 0.24 m. Measured outer bounds include roof/flashing thickness.
Front is Blender -Y. Closed 6 x 4.4 m sliding door on long front side with external sliding rail; wall opening exists behind door.
Physical corrugated steel sheets have thickness, perimeter closures, corner uprights, verge and ridge flashing.
Pivot at footprint centre, ground level. Exterior-only prop; collision closes the building volume.
Defaults and material colours are editable in Scripts/build_barn_fence.py. All geometry and textures are original CC0.

pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: Actual diamond wire geometry: diagonal galvanized wires, approximately 0.12 m horizontal and vertical diamond spans.
One post only, at the start. Nominal module length exactly 3.0 m in Blender +X; place repeats at X=0,3,6... with identical rotation.
Pivot at ground, starting post centre. Physical bounds include post radius before X=0; this does not alter the 3 m repeat pitch.
Mesh and horizontal rails terminate at X=3.0 m and meet the next post; no doubled posts. Add Fence_Post at the final X endpoint.
Blender front -Y, Z up; FBX forward -Y / up Z, FBX Units Scale.
Original CC0 geometry and textures; geometry mesh is opaque and needs no alpha-test setup.
